summary: Narrow private-looking lane serving houses; no room to stop, homes within 15 m.
reasons: Lane narrower than a van pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Tree-screened, but dwellings sit 9-15 m from the lane along most of it, and the end reaches a carport 2 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Single-width gravel and sealed lane under canopy with a vehicle parked in it; no wider ground beside it to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Very little traffic, access to a few homes only.
drivers.convention: No signs; looks like a residents' access lane, no camper parking seen.

flags: Lane may be a private driveway
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the whole lane.
